data.title: Hail Records High Tourism Occupancy Rates as School Break Begins and 'Wasm Hail' Launches
data.content:
Hail, November 21, 2026, SPA -- Hail Region has witnessed a surge in tourist arrivals with the start of the school break, coinciding with the launch of the "Wasm Hail" events. Tourism establishments across the region have recorded high occupancy rates, according to field observations by the Hail Region Development Authority.
    Occupancy rates reached 100% at serviced apartments, 99.6% at hotels, and 96% at resorts and rural lodges, reflecting strong demand for tourist accommodation in the region during this period.
    Hail offers diverse tourism attractions, combining mountainous and desert landscapes with historical and heritage sites. The region also hosts a variety of events, experiences, and activities catering to different visitor interests, offering numerous ways to explore the area and reinforcing its position as a year-round tourist destination.
    -- SPA
